text: Reference executable format shall be `smil.ref.image.v1` with UTF-8 JSON descriptor and fixed-placement raw segments, recording target/contracts/digests, entry, segment bounds/kinds/digests, catalogs, initialization order, and user IDs. Segments shall lie wholly in permitted regions; unmapped holes shall not be ordinary RAM.
